title: tetracme quadricornis
intro: Tetracme quadricornis, commonly known as Four Horns or Four-horned Tetracme, is a plant species native to the Himalayan region, belonging to the family Brassicaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The plant is known to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Tetracme quadricornis include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
